criteria.quote: Jolteon’s breath crackles because its lungs make electricity.
criteria.revision: Replace the opening with: “Jolteon’s fur isn’t the only place its electricity crackles—its lungs contain an organ that creates electricity.” This creates a stronger contrast before explaining the breath.

criteria.quote: Its lungs contain an organ that creates electricity.
What links Jolteon’s lungs to its crackling breath?
criteria.revision: Hold back the answer after introducing the fur: “Jolteon’s fur can make a constant sparking noise. But what happens when that electricity-making organ is inside its lungs?” Reveal the organ and exhale connection afterward.

criteria.quote: That organ inside its lungs creates electricity.
criteria.revision: Reorder the evidence so each beat adds a new detail: first, its fur creates a constant sparking noise; next, its lungs contain an electricity-making organ; finally, electricity can be heard crackling when it exhales.

Move “Its fur already crackles” before revealing the lungs, then introduce: “But one Pokédex entry puts an electricity-making organ inside its lungs.” The lung detail becomes the reveal instead of appearing in the title and first scene.

criteria.quote: Its breath crackles because its lungs make electricity.
criteria.revision: Give each scene a distinct fact: fur creates a constant sparking noise; mood changes charge its power; its lungs contain an electricity-making organ; exhaling makes the electricity crackle audible. Remove the repeated lines about the organ and crackling exhale.

criteria.quote: Jolteon’s electricity can spark in its fur and crackle in its breath.
criteria.revision: End with a synthesis that resolves the contrast: “Jolteon’s electricity is audible in two places: its fur creates a constant sparking noise, and its lungs can make electricity that crackles when it exhales.”

criteria.quote: Which is stranger: sparking fur or crackling breath?
criteria.revision: Make the split more specific: “Which changes how you see Jolteon more: fur that creates a constant sparking noise, or lungs containing an organ that creates electricity?”
